Agent onboarding: signup URL, auto-created key, free-credit budget and the 402 top-up path. Attribution links refreshed.

Initial release – search, fetch, and analyze Indeed job postings and employer data via Scavio.

- Search for job postings by keyword, location, and filters (radius, job type, age, salary, remote).
- Retrieve detailed data for a single job posting, including structured salary, benefits, ATS link, and description.
- Pull comprehensive employer profiles with industry, size, revenue, ratings, salaries, and open roles.
- Read paginated employee reviews with per-category ratings, pros/cons, and aggregated insights.
- All endpoints return structured JSON for integration with recruiting and labor market research.
